description: Map which combinations of two process parameters produce a cosmetically acceptable part, and how much room surrounds the center. Sweep wider than you expect the window to be: a passing point on the edge of the range tested means the window was never closed on that side. Axes and their units: hold_pressure (psi), melt_temp (°C), mold_temp (°C), injection_velocity (in/s), hold_time (s), cooling_time (s). Defects: short, flash, sink, burn, splay, weld-line, drag, warp.

pass.description: Did the part meet the cosmetic criteria?

x.description: Value on the x axis, in the unit of whichever axis xAxis selects

y.description: Value on the y axis, in the unit of whichever axis yAxis selects

study_code.description: A study as the Lab card encodes it; use instead of the measurements (xAxis, yAxis, points)

xAxis.description: Horizontal parameter. Units by axis: hold_pressure (psi), melt_temp (°C), mold_temp (°C), injection_velocity (in/s), hold_time (s), cooling_time (s).

yAxis.description: Vertical parameter. Units by axis: hold_pressure (psi), melt_temp (°C), mold_temp (°C), injection_velocity (in/s), hold_time (s), cooling_time (s).
